title: eta-epsilon joint temperature-resolved observation table: the build contract
lock_rule: The schema, the quality-layer rule, the merge rules, the exclusion list and the evaluation contract are frozen before the first build. Later rounds may add columns; they may not relax a rule, and a rule that has to change is reported as a correction rather than edited in place.
why: Appendix Z-5立项ed the eta-epsilon joint temperature-resolved dataset as paper-2 material on six axes: open, per-value provenance, temperature-resolved, machine-checkable, honest evaluation and an applicability gate. Those axes are cheap to claim and expensive to hold, so they are written down as a schema and a set of rules before any row is assembled.

axis_mapping.open: licence and redistributable are per-row columns; the restricted 858 rows are excluded by construction, not by convention
axis_mapping.per_value_provenance: source_doi + source_file + source_row_index + source_file_sha256 on every row
axis_mapping.temperature_resolved: T_K is required and has no default; a row without a temperature is not an observation
axis_mapping.machine_checkable: a verifier recomputes the schema, the unit rule and the digests, and a manifest pins the table
axis_mapping.honest_evaluation: GroupKFold by InChIKey with an asserted group_overlap == 0; random-row is a leak reference only
axis_mapping.applicability: phase, method, n_components and the quality layer travel with the row so a gate can be defined later without re-reading the sources

observation_schema.grain: one measured value at one temperature for one substance, from one source row

columns.name: row_id
columns.note: stable, {dataset_id}:{source_row_index}; the merge never renumbers a source row

columns.name: dataset_id
columns.note: which corpus the row came from; one of the frozen enum below

columns.name: property
columns.note: epsilon or viscosity; the joint table exists for exactly these two

columns.name: property_family
columns.note: dielectric_constant or dynamic_viscosity

columns.name: inchikey
columns.note: the identity key AND the cross-validation group key; never a name, never a CID

columns.name: name
columns.note: display only, never joined on

columns.name: smiles
columns.note: carried for feature recomputation; the identity check is the InChIKey

columns.name: T_K
columns.note: kelvin; no room-temperature default

columns.name: value
columns.note: the measured value in the canonical unit below

columns.name: unit
columns.note: canonical unit: '1' for epsilon, 'Pa*s' for viscosity; never mixed inside the column

columns.name: phase
columns.note: as reported by the source

columns.name: method
columns.note: the measurement method as the source states it; empty is allowed and means unstated

columns.name: uncertainty
columns.note: source uncertainty, original scale

columns.name: uncertainty_kind
columns.note: expanded / standard / unknown; an uncertainty without its kind is not comparable

columns.name: confidence_level
columns.note: as reported

columns.name: frequency_mhz
columns.note: epsilon only; a dielectric value without its frequency is not a defined measurement

columns.name: pressure_kpa
columns.note: as reported

columns.name: n_components
columns.note: 1 for a pure substance; the modelled target is the pure-substance subset

columns.name: pure_or_mixture
columns.note: pure or mixture

columns.name: source_doi
columns.note: required for quality_layer=publishable_core, allowed empty only in filter_only

columns.name: source_kind
columns.note: primary_thermoml_measurement / published_supplement_open_subset / compilation

columns.name: source_file
columns.note: the file the row was read from

columns.name: source_row_index
columns.note: 0-based index in that file

columns.name: source_file_sha256
columns.note: the digest of the source file at build time; provenance that can be rechecked

columns.name: quality_layer
columns.note: publishable_core or filter_only; see the two-layer rule

columns.name: licence
columns.note: thermoml_open / cc_by_4_0 / publisher_terms_see_source; recorded per row, not per project

columns.name: redistributable
columns.note: false for every row whose source terms forbid redistribution, regardless of quality layer

observation_schema.identity_rule: the primary key is (inchikey, property, T_K, source_file, source_row_index); a duplicate on that key is a defect, not a merge candidate
observation_schema.unit_rule: epsilon is dimensionless and stored as unit='1'; viscosity is stored in Pa*s and the cP copy the sources carry is NOT a second column here, it is recomputed by anyone who wants it
observation_schema.temperature_rule: T_K is kelvin, one value per row, taken from the source; a value quoted at 'room temperature' without a number does not enter

quality_layers.publishable_core: a first-hand source DOI is present and the value is an experimental measurement reported by that source. These are the rows the dataset is defended on.
quality_layers.filter_only: compilation-level values (PubChem depositor aggregates, safety sheets). Allowed into the table with quality_layer=filter_only so the funnel can use them, never quoted as a core value and never counted in the publishable headline.
quality_layers.rule: a row is publishable_core only if source_kind is a measurement and source_doi is non-empty and quality_layer says so explicitly; the layer is a stored column, never inferred at read time

merge_rules.no_averaging: conflicting values at the same (inchikey, property, T_K) are all kept; they are never averaged, and the conflict count is reported per key
merge_rules.no_silent_drops: a row excluded from the table is written to an exclusions file with the reason; a shrinking row count without an exclusion record is a defect
merge_rules.provenance_is_not_optional: every row keeps source_file and source_row_index; a row that cannot be traced back to a source row does not enter

exclusions.rule: never fetched, never inferred, never reconstructed; the 3582-row open subset is the whole of what this project may use
predicted values are not observations; they do not enter the observation table
restricted_crosscheck_only; they adjudicate conflicts and never enter a distributable dataset
they may be stored, but the modelled target is the pure-substance subset and a mixture row is not silently treated as pure

evaluation_contract.group_overlap_assertion: the builder and any benchmark assert group_overlap == 0 between train and test groups; a failing assertion is a stop, not a warning
evaluation_contract.random_row_role: a leak reference only. It is reported next to the grouped reading and never enters a verdict. The viscosity line already paid for this: random_row 0.93689 vs group_key 0.74813.
evaluation_contract.why: the same compound appears at many temperatures. Splitting rows at random puts the same compound on both sides of the split and the temperature series leaks; the reading stops being an out-of-sample reading at exactly the moment it starts looking good.

checks: every required column is present and non-empty according to its rule
unit is consistent with property on every row
quality_layer=publishable_core implies source_kind is a measurement and source_doi is non-empty
redistributable=false rows are enumerated by source in the manifest
the primary key has no duplicates
every excluded row has an exclusion record
verification_contract.manifest: a SHA256 manifest over the built table, the exclusions file and the builder script

forbidden: fetching or reconstructing the restricted 858 values
letting a predicted value into the observation table
letting a Reaxys value into a distributable artefact
storing a row without source_file and source_row_index
inferring the quality layer at read time instead of storing it
row-level random splits for any conclusion
quoting the publishable headline over a table that includes filter_only rows
